definition.content:
Deployment scope: ecluse_deployment:platform-east. HTTP traffic includes proxy probes. Advisory ecosystem selection applies only to advisory metrics.

Missing data is unknown. Sparse counters can be absent before the first event. Cache and breaker gauges retain their last recorded value. The dashboard does not prove readiness.

Recorded version denials are not denied requests or a complete count of versions removed from successful metadata responses. Dredger examined and outcome counts must not be added together.

Memory ratios group by pod_name. This tag must uniquely identify a telemetry producer.

Idle credential expiry alone is not a provider fault. Advisory publication age, not installation age, governs freshness.

[Operations](https://ecluse-proxy.com/docs/operations/)

queries.name: q0
queries.query: sum:ecluse.rule.denials{ecluse_deployment:platform-east AND $env AND $service AND (service:ecluse-proxy) AND reason_class:policy} by {rule}.as_rate()

queries.name: q1
queries.query: sum:ecluse.rule.denials{ecluse_deployment:platform-east AND $env AND $service AND (service:ecluse-proxy) AND NOT reason_class:policy} by {reason_class}.as_rate()
